definitions.explanation: A written symbol representing a sound or meaning, including hiragana, katakana, kanji, and letters from other writing systems.

examples.japanese: この{字|じ}は{何|なん}と{読|よ}みますか。
examples.english: How do you read this character?

examples.japanese: {字|じ}が{上手|じょうず}ですね。
{小|ちい}さい{字|じ}が{見|み}えません。

notes:
{字|じ} refers to written characters of any type.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {字|じ}を{書|か}く: to write characters
- {字|じ}を{読|よ}む: to read characters
- {字|じ}が{上手|じょうず}/下手|へた}: good/bad handwriting
- {漢字|かんじ}: Chinese characters (kanji)
- ローマ{字|じ}: Roman letters

RELATED TERMS:
- {文字|もじ}: character, letter (more formal)
- ひらがな: hiragana
- カタカナ: katakana
- {漢字|かんじ}: kanji

Note: When talking about handwriting quality, {字|じ} often refers to how nicely someone writes.
